name: @cadfixer/file-formats
description: Format descriptors, UI-level filename screening, resource budgets, byte-based format identification, the STL codec, and the OBJ and 3MF readers with their bounded ZIP and XML scanners. Reading only: there is no OBJ or 3MF writer.
//exports: ./threemf-fixtures exposes the hand-authored hostile and valid ZIP/3MF archives so the worker and application suites exercise the SAME corpus the reader package does, rather than each growing a divergent copy. Test-only: no production path imports it, and the boundary scan checks that.
